name: DoD Zero Trust Strategy
purpose: The target state for zero trust across the {{dow.current}}, with a date on it.
what: Seven pillars, 45 capabilities and 152 activities at two levels. Target Level, 91 activities, is due by the end of fiscal year 2027.

binds.line: Directs {{dow}} components. Others may borrow the pillar model but are not bound by it.

verifiedBy.line: Components report against the activities, and solutions are assessed against them, as Flank Speed was.

note: Lensatic does not list the pillars, capabilities and activities on this screen yet. The Field Guide’s quick reference has all seven pillars and every capability.

sits.line: Layer 3. It sets the target state; the zero trust overlays tie it to controls one layer down.

terms.line: A work of the United States government. Lensatic shows the card only for now.

related.line: The strategy points to SP 800-207 for what zero trust means.
The civilian counterpart: five pillars where the department has seven.
The department’s zero trust overlays select from this catalog.
